name: Being Nervous
overview: Scripture teaches that believers need not be nervous or fearful because God is always present to strengthen, help, and protect them. The Lord commands us to be strong and courageous, assuring us of His constant presence wherever we go. Trusting in God's care means we can cast aside worries about our daily needs, knowing He provides and watches over us through His angels. Ultimately, calling upon the name of the Lord brings salvation and peace that dispels anxiety.
